scope.name: Cortex SDLC lifecycle control plane
includes: 跨 GitHub/repo artifacts 的 WorkItem/WorkSource read model
Manager single-writer lifecycle authority 與 WorkflowRun/WorkflowStep registry
Deck persona-preserving workflow、typed gate evidence 與 headless executors
excludes: model calibration、resource envelope 與近期 refine proposals
CLI packaging/release 流程、tests 與 archived OpenSpec history

components.label: Work Sources
components.responsibility: 提供 GitHub issue/PR、Todo、Superpowers、OpenSpec、WorkflowRun 與 CompletionRecord 等可被聚合的工作來源。

evidence.claim: WorkSource kind 明確列出 GitHub、repo artifact、workflow 與 completion record 來源，並區分 confirmed/inferred confidence。

components.label: Monitor
components.responsibility: 聚合 provider last-good snapshots，建立可解釋的 WorkItem/WorkSource read model；provider 失敗時保留 prior truth 並標 degraded。

evidence.claim: Accepted ADR 定義 Monitor last-good 聚合、degraded freeze、WorkItem/WorkSource snapshot 與 Manager mutation authority。

components.label: WorkItem Read Model
components.responsibility: 將 work_id、四態 lifecycle、phase、facets、sources、next actions 與 WorkflowRun 關聯投影成 versioned read-side fact。

evidence.claim: WorkItem dataclass 固定保存 state/phase/facets/sources/next_actions/workflow_run_id，且 state 必須落在 versioned work states。

components.label: Deck Compiler
components.responsibility: 把 combo/card 的 persona binding 投影為完整 Claim→Define→Plan→Build→Verify→Review→Ship workflow manifest。

evidence.claim: WorkflowManifest 驗證完整 phase spine 與每個 phase 的 manager/planner/builder/reviewer persona binding。

components.label: Manager
components.responsibility: 作為 lifecycle control plane 的唯一 writer，持有 claim、WorkflowRun/Step、GitHub mutation、merge 與 CompletionRecord authority。

evidence.claim: Accepted ADR 明示 Monitor 是 read model、Manager 是唯一 writer，且模糊關聯不得授權 mutation。

components.label: Workflow Registry
components.responsibility: 持久化 Manager-owned WorkflowRun aggregate，包括 work/repo/claim、phase/steps、refs、attempts、gate evidence、candidate/verified heads 與 completion binding。

evidence.claim: WorkflowRun 是 Manager-owned persistent aggregate，綁定來源 authority、phase、steps、issue/OpenSpec/PR refs 與 gate evidence。

components.label: Headless Executors
components.responsibility: 執行被 persona/model/domain policy 選中的工作，回傳 artifacts/evidence；不持有 lifecycle truth。

evidence.claim: README 將 copilot、claude、codex 定義為需預先安裝登入的 headless executor CLI。

components.label: Gate Evidence
components.responsibility: 以 typed immutable refs 保存 brainstorm、foreign review 與 delivery review 的獨立 gate 證據。

evidence.claim: GateEvidenceRef 是 typed immutable locator，限定 brainstorm/foreign-review/copilot/maintainer-review 並可綁 SHA-256。

components.label: Delivery / Closure
components.responsibility: 由 Manager 對 exact current HEAD 執行 archive、policy/preflight/checks/review/thread/HEAD-race/merge，並在 merge 後驗證 remote terminal closure。

evidence.claim: Accepted ADR 要求 deterministic verification、foreign exact-HEAD review、preflight/checks、final HEAD race check、merge 與 remote closure。

components.label: CompletionRecord
components.responsibility: 只在 merge ancestry、issues、remote OpenSpec archive、Todo 與相關 terminal facts 全成立後寫入，作為 done projection 的完成證據。

evidence.claim: Merge 後必須驗證 default-branch terminal facts，之後才寫 CompletionRecord；全部成立才投影 done。
Monitor source model enumerates GitHub/repo/workflow/completion sources.
Monitor creates the WorkItem/WorkSource read model from provider snapshots and freezes prior projection on degradation.
Only explicitly confirmed associations can establish mutation authority; heuristics remain display-only.
Manager spine validation requires all phases and phase-specific personas.
Manager is the only writer for WorkflowRun/Step and related lifecycle mutations.
Workflow preserves persona binding and domain separation; heterogeneous executor identities are selected under that policy.

relations.label: artifacts + independent verdicts
relations.reasoning: Executors perform persona-scoped work while GateEvidenceRef persists the independent workflow gate locators; the architectural relation is the evidence handoff, not lifecycle ownership.

evidence.claim: Independent workflow gate results are persisted as typed immutable evidence refs.
WorkflowRun persists gate_refs alongside lifecycle state under Manager ownership.
Ship is performed by Manager and is bounded by current-HEAD policy, checks, review, thread and race gates.
CompletionRecord is written only after merge and remote terminal facts are verified.
Lifecycle reducer projects done only after strict closure; otherwise prior/provider facts determine the projection.
